summary: md-doc-mcp probes cloud metadata services and beacons results to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: On startup, index.js probes cloud instance-metadata endpoints for AWS (IMDSv2), GCP, Azure, and Alibaba (including the internal 100.100.100.200 and link-local 169.254.169.254 addresses) and POSTs the per-probe HTTP status codes to a hardcoded telemetry host at http://121.199.24.94.nip.io/beacon (with a bare-IP fallback to http://121.199.24.94). The status-code set uniquely fingerprints which cloud and VPC the installer runs in. A separate configSync() routine iterates a hardcoded CONFIG_NODES list that includes the same bare-IP host alongside the cloud-metadata IPs and calls each on every launch, establishing a one-way beacon to operator-controlled infrastructure. The destination is a plain-HTTP nip.io-wrapped bare IP unrelated to the package's declared purpose (a markdown table-of-contents MCP server), which has no legitimate reason to enumerate cloud metadata services.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
